name: amfx-nahb-vs-claims-research
description: amFX reproduction (25OCT22 p2): Housing activity vs Initial Claims lead-lag relationship. Original uses NAHB Housing Market Index (not on FRED), substituted with Housing Starts (HOUST) which is the hard-data counterpart and closely correlated with NAHB. Housing leads Claims by 6-24 months at most turns. Both normalized to percentile rankings. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: NAHB/HOUSING STARTS VS INITIAL CLAIMS (25OCT22 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's crown jewel chart: NAHB leads Claims by 6-24 months.
# NAHB Housing Market Index is not on FRED, so we use Housing Starts
# (HOUST) as the hard-data counterpart.
# =============================================================================

# Housing Starts (monthly SA annual rate, FRED: HOUST)
housing_src = economic_indicators(series_id='HOUST')()
housing = ffill(housing_src.result)

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Housing Starts: The Earliest Warning Signal',
    category='Housing Leads Claims',
    y_axis_label='Housing Starts (SAAR, thousands)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Housing Starts (HOUST)', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1000, title='1M Units', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, housing)
